in_marathi.name: Ramvilash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Abode, God's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramvilash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Vilash means 'Abode' or 'Grace'. This name signifies that the person carrying this name is blessed by the Gods and lives in their grace.
